Category.guidance: Enter the category from the change request form. Describe the proposed change.

Requestor.guidance: Enter the name of the person requesting the change.

Submission date.guidance: Enter the date the change was submitted.

الحالة.guidance: Enter the status as open, pending, closed.

Disposition.guidance: Enter the outcome of the change request as approved, deferred, or rejected.
